name: Original Payment Instruction 52
definition: Provides details on the original transactions, to which the status report message refers.

OriginalPaymentInformationIdentification.name: Original Payment Information Identification
OriginalPaymentInformationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original sending party, to unambiguously identify the original payment information group.

OriginalNumberOfTransactions.name: Original Number Of Transactions
OriginalNumberOfTransactions.definition: Number of individual transactions contained in the original payment information group.

OriginalControlSum.name: Original Control Sum
OriginalControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the original payment information group, irrespective of currencies.

PaymentInformationStatus.name: Payment Information Status
PaymentInformationStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the payment information group.

StatusReasonInformation.name: Status Reason Information
StatusReasonInformation.definition: Provides detailed information on the status reason.

NumberOfTransactionsPerStatus.name: Number Of Transactions Per Status
NumberOfTransactionsPerStatus.definition: Detailed information on the number of transactions for each identical transaction status.

TransactionInformationAndStatus.name: Transaction Information And Status
TransactionInformationAndStatus.definition: Provides information on the original transactions to which the status report message refers.

PaymentInformationStatusAcceptedRule.definition: If PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to ACTC (AcceptedTechnicalValidation), ACCP (AcceptedCustomerProfile), ACSP (AcceptedSettlementInProcess), ACSC (AcceptedSettlementCompleted) or ACWC (AcceptedWithChange), then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus must be different from RJCT (Rejected).

PaymentInformationStatusPendingRule.definition: If PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to PDNG, then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus must be different from RJCT.

PaymentInformationStatusRejectedRule.definition: If PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to RJCT, then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus, if present, must be equal to RJCT.

PaymentInformationStatusReceivedRule.definition: If PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to RCVD, then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus is not allowed.
